option_relations.rationale: Tumors of the follicular infundibulum are benign adnexal tumors, but the provided leaf is multiple syringomas, which are eccrine sweat gland tumors. There is no direct relation.

Clear cell hidradenoma is a benign adnexal tumor of eccrine origin, but the provided leaf is multiple syringomas, which are also eccrine sweat gland tumors but distinct entities. There is no direct relation.
